snippet.title: Light of Lithos – VR Prototype Gameplay
snippet.description:
Experience a first look at Light of Lithos, an immersive narrative platformer coming to Meta Quest in Q2 2027.

This early gameplay showcase offers a glimpse into the world, mechanics, and atmospheric journey currently in development at VANOVA.
